source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
and release exactly one each time I press a lever,
so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify how it should release exactly one item, only that it must.
The request does not specify how the dispenser is mounted on the wall.
The request does not specify dimensions or materials, only that it holds about twenty small items and is wall-mounted.
The request does not specify the shape or operation of the lever, only that pressing it releases exactly one item.
The request does not specify the type of small items.

assumptions.statement: The user will press the lever to dispense items one at a time.
assumptions.why: The request describes pressing a lever to release items.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A change to the operation method.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser will be used for small items that can be stored and released individually.
assumptions.why: The request says 'small items' and 'release exactly one'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A specification of items that cannot be individually dispensed.
